description: Defines the SensorRegistrationInfo class used for representing sensor registration details in Android's sensor service, including timestamp, handle, package name, sampling rate, report latency, activation status, and process/user IDs.

classes.name: SensorService::SensorRegistrationInfo
classes.description: Represents sensor registration information including handle, package, timing, activation status, and process IDs, with methods for dumping info and serialization.

methods.name: SensorRegistrationInfo()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing members to default values.

methods.name: SensorRegistrationInfo(int32_t handle, const String8 &packageName, int64_t samplingRateNs, int64_t maxReportLatencyNs, bool activate)
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing members based on input parameters and capturing current time and process IDs.

methods.name: isSentinel
methods.description: Checks if the registration info is a sentinel (invalid) entry.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string with formatted debug information about the registration.

methods.name: dump (protobuf)
methods.description: Serializes registration info into a protobuf message.
